chapter: Setting the record straight on Hendersonia
title: Sprat Morton, Helen Humes' husband
summary: Trumpeter James 'Spratman' Morton from Louisville, whom Roy replaced, was the husband of singer Helen Humes, and introduced Horace to her.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: There was a trumpet player that Roy took his place named Sprat. There's a little history behind him.
Sprat Morton. Sprat Morton -- maybe a lot of people don't know --he was a nice trumpet

player from Louisville, Kentucky, He had nanny in his... a little (unintelligible), but he could read. He had a little shake in his tone. But the main thing was a lot of people don't know that he was the husband of a great singer, Helen Humes.
Yes. That was her husband. great.

We called him Spratman -- James Spratman. She did a lot of things down in -- even at Shelley Mann and the Manhole The Cellar -- Shelley Mann and the Manhole -- Helen Humes. And I had the pleasure of playing for her a lot, and, of course, Sprat that was her husband -- he introduced me to her (unintelligible).
I wanted to inject that, check that.
